Class ChartData

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.ChartData
public final class ChartData extends Object
A chart of a model: a line chart of values over the steps (chart), an XY chart (chartXY, e.g., a phase plot) or a bar chart (chartBars, replaced in each call). Shown in the Charts view of Bio7 and in the HTML page.
